title: Scope change: build only the front (home) page for the Renev-style agency site

requirements.text: Implement a single-page Home (front page) experience only (no additional routes/pages), inspired by the Renev modern creative digital agency style, with a cohesive section-based layout (e.g., Hero, About snapshot, Services overview, Featured work/Portfolio highlights, Testimonials, Metrics/Stats, CTA, Footer).

quotes: this time just built the front page only

acceptanceCriteria: The app renders a single Home/front page only and does not expose separate About/Services/Portfolio/Blog/Contact pages/routes.
The Home page includes multiple clearly separated, modern marketing sections (at minimum: Hero + 4 additional sections + Footer).
Content is written in English and reads like a modern creative digital agency landing page.

requirements.text: Add an on-page navigation header for the Home page that uses anchor links to scroll to sections on the same page (single-page navigation).

quotes: this time just built the front page only

acceptanceCriteria: Header navigation links scroll to the corresponding sections on the same page.
Smooth scrolling is enabled for in-page section navigation.
The currently active section is visually indicated in the navigation as the user scrolls.

requirements.text: Define and apply one coherent visual theme for the Home page (colors, typography, spacing, buttons, cards, and section styling) matching a modern creative digital agency aesthetic, and keep it consistent across all Home sections.

quotes: this time just built the front page only

acceptanceCriteria: A single consistent design system is evident across all Home sections (typography scale, spacing rhythm, button styles, card styles).
The page looks polished on both mobile and desktop breakpoints.
No blue+purple default theme is used unless it emerges incidentally from the chosen palette; prefer a distinct, modern agency palette.

requirements.text: Add modern UI interactions on the Home page: hover/press states for interactive elements and subtle scroll-reveal animations for major sections as they enter the viewport.

quotes: this time just built the front page only

acceptanceCriteria: Buttons/links/cards have clear hover and active/pressed states.
Major sections reveal with subtle animation on scroll (without impacting readability or performance).
Animations do not block navigation and do not trap focus (keyboard navigation remains usable).

requirements.text: Drive the Home page sections from a small set of reusable frontend content data structures (e.g., arrays/objects for services, featured projects, testimonials, stats) to avoid duplicative hardcoding across the page.

quotes: this time just built the front page only

acceptanceCriteria: At least services, featured projects, and testimonials (or comparable sets) are rendered from centralized arrays/objects.
Updating an item in the data structure updates the rendered UI without editing multiple locations.

requirements.text: Provide basic SEO and accessibility fundamentals for the single Home page: semantic heading structure, alt text for images, and page-level meta title/description for the Home route.

quotes: this time just built the front page only

acceptanceCriteria: Headings follow a semantic hierarchy (one H1, logical H2/H3 structure).
All meaningful images include descriptive alt text (decorative images use empty alt where appropriate).
Home route has a meta title and description set.

requirements.text: Add and render locally generated static images for the Home page under frontend/public/assets/generated and use them in the Hero and other key Home sections (e.g., featured work thumbnails and testimonial avatars).

quotes: this time just built the front page only

acceptanceCriteria: All required generated images exist under frontend/public/assets/generated and are referenced by the Home page UI.
Hero section uses a generated hero visual.
Featured work/testimonials sections use generated thumbnails/avatars rather than external URLs.

constraints: Frontend immutable paths must not be edited: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui.
Use React + TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and existing UI composition patterns; do not introduce unsupported frameworks.
Backend should remain unchanged unless strictly necessary for the front page.
nonGoals: Do not implement multi-page routing (About/Services detail/Portfolio detail/Blog/Contact pages).
Do not implement a backend-backed contact form submission for this scope (front page only).
Do not add third-party authentication or external database integrations.
